#!/bin/bash
# Run probe to comprehensively document RAG stream endpoints and briefly document rest of API
# For design lead context

cd "$(dirname "$0")"

python3 run_probe.py \
  --query "Document the 2ndOpinionMD API architecture, focusing on RAG stream endpoints (/rag/ask_stream, /rag/coding_stream, /rag/eoh_stream, /rag/eoh_detective_stream) with comprehensive detail, and other API endpoints (SNOMED, DisGeNET, etc.) with brief 1-2 sentence summaries per item. Structure the output so a frontend engineer can wire UI components directly: include endpoint purpose, required params, optional params, streaming event types, and example SSE payloads where applicable." \
  --suffix "api_documentation" \
  --queries \
    '{"topic": "Comprehensively document /rag/ask_stream endpoint: request/response format, parameters, retrieval strategy (ANN/BM25/RRF fusion), source routing, streaming behavior, error handling, and integration with guideline sources.", "ts_terms": ["ask_stream", "ask_stream_event_generator", "/api/rag/ask_stream", "guideline_sources", "RRF", "ANN", "BM25"]}' \
    '{"topic": "Comprehensively document /rag/coding_stream endpoint: request/response format, parameters, TS-only retrieval strategy, code source routing (ICD10CM, ICD11, SNOMED, LOINC, RxNorm), per-source limits, streaming behavior, and coding-specific prompts.", "ts_terms": ["coding_stream", "coding_stream_event_generator", "/api/rag/coding_stream", "CODE_SOURCES", "CODING_TS_K", "icd10cm", "icd11", "snomed", "loinc", "rxnorm"]}' \
    '{"topic": "Comprehensively document /rag/eoh_stream endpoint: request/response format, patient_state parameter, EoH LLM router integration, module routing, timeline summarization, source selection, streaming behavior, and Ethos-of-Health integration.", "ts_terms": ["eoh_stream", "eoh_stream_event_generator", "/api/rag/eoh_stream", "patient_state", "eoh_router", "timeline", "ethos", "EOH_SYSTEM_PROMPT"]}' \
    '{"topic": "Comprehensively document /rag/eoh_detective_stream endpoint: request/response format, multi-step investigation workflow, orchestration pattern, internal delegation to eoh_stream, step-by-step reasoning, and detective-specific behavior.", "ts_terms": ["eoh_detective_stream", "eoh_detective_stream_event_generator", "/api/rag/eoh_detective_stream", "detective", "multi-step", "orchestration"]}' \
    '{"topic": "Document the Frontend Contract Summary for all RAG stream endpoints: shared SSE contract (text/event-stream transport), event.type semantic meaning, event.data JSON structure, and how a single EventSource handler can support all modes (ask_stream, coding_stream, eoh_stream, eoh_detective_stream).", "ts_terms": ["EventSourceResponse", "SSE", "text/event-stream", "event.type", "event.data", "EventSource", "streaming", "sse_starlette"]}' \
    '{"topic": "Document Event Schema Stability requirements: how SSE event payloads are semi-structured and may evolve, frontend client requirements (tolerate unknown event types, tolerate additional fields, treat missing optional fields as non-fatal), and schema versioning approach.", "ts_terms": ["event", "schema", "payload", "optional", "fields", "versioning", "backward compatible", "forward compatible"]}' \
    '{"topic": "Briefly document other routes (eg SNOMED, DisGeNET, etc.) (ontologies, vocabularies, guidelines, etc.) API endpoints: purpose, data model, and key operations (1-2 sentences).", "ts_terms": ["snomed", "snomed_routes", "/api/snomed", "disgenet", "disgenet_routes", "/api/disgenet"]}'


  --terms \
    "ask_stream" "coding_stream" "eoh_stream" "eoh_detective_stream" \
    "rag_stream_routes" "stream_router" "stream_config" \
    "snomed" "disgenet" "seed" \
    "APIRouter" "router.get" "router.post" \
    "EventSourceResponse" "SSE" "streaming" "text/event-stream" \
    "event.type" "event.data" "EventSource" "sse_starlette" \
    "event" "schema" "payload" "optional" "fields" "versioning" \
    "ANN" "BM25" "RRF" "hybrid_retrieval" \
    "patient_state" "timeline" "eoh_router" \
    "coding_mode" "guideline_sources" "code_sources"

#!/bin/bash
# Run 10 probes for EoH v5.2 mechanical constraints

python3 ai_code_pipelines/run_probe.py \
  --query "Strengthen EoH v5.2 by introducing explicit mechanical constraints, deterministic reasoning rules, and enforceable invariants across diagnostic landscape modeling, drift detection, suppression lifecycle, governance ordering, and authority boundaries with the Medical Knowledge Engine (MKE). The goal is to convert high-level conceptual descriptions into patent-defensible, operationally constrained embodiments without introducing implementation-specific code." \
  --suffix "eoh_v5_2_mechanical_constraints" \
  --queries \
    '{"topic":"Define the canonical Diagnostic Landscape data model with required fields and update rules, including temporal span, confidence vector, provenance references, suppression status, and explicit comparison to prior inferred states.","ts_terms":["Diagnostic Landscape","inferred state","temporal span","confidence vector","provenance","suppression status","state comparison","prior state"]}' \
    '{"topic":"Specify explicit state update function constraints for EoH inferred states, including required inputs, ordering of evaluation, immutability of prior states, and conditions under which new states may be created or existing states modified.","ts_terms":["state update","inferred state update","prior state","immutability","state transition","update ordering"]}' \
    '{"topic":"Constrain drift detection by defining at least one canonical operational embodiment, including drift magnitude, direction, persistence, and a minimum actionable rule based on confidence threshold crossing over defined temporal intervals.","ts_terms":["drift detection","confidence threshold","temporal interval","drift magnitude","drift persistence","confidence band crossing"]}' \
    '{"topic":"Define suppression lifecycle mechanics for inferred states, explicitly distinguishing temporary versus persistent suppression, reactivation conditions, and guarantees that suppression does not delete historical state records.","ts_terms":["suppression lifecycle","temporary suppression","persistent suppression","state reactivation","non-deletion","historical state"]}' \
    '{"topic":"Document governance decision ordering within EoH, including mandatory sequencing of abstention checks, suppression evaluation, state update comparison, and confidence mediation prior to any external output generation.","ts_terms":["governance ordering","abstention","suppression evaluation","decision sequence","confidence mediation"]}' \
    '{"topic":"Explicitly define abstention as a first-class reasoning outcome within EoH, including conditions that require abstention, how abstention is logged, and how abstention interacts with concurrent inferred states.","ts_terms":["abstention","first-class outcome","reasoning abstention","concurrent states","governance log"]}' \
    '{"topic":"Constrain concurrent inferred state handling by specifying rules for non-exclusive state coexistence, conflict tolerance, confidence weighting across states, and prohibition of forced collapse into a single diagnosis.","ts_terms":["concurrent inferred states","non-exclusive states","confidence weighting","state coexistence","no forced collapse"]}' \
    '{"topic":"Define explicit authority boundaries between the Medical Knowledge Engine (MKE) and EoH, including rules that retrieved knowledge artifacts are non-authoritative until elevated by EoH through time- and confidence-mediated reasoning.","ts_terms":["Medical Knowledge Engine","MKE","authority boundary","non-authoritative artifacts","state elevation","confidence mediation"]}' \
    '{"topic":"Specify provenance and audit invariants for EoH reasoning, including mandatory linkage between inferred states, source artifacts, timestamps, confidence vectors, and governance decisions suitable for regulatory and patent examination.","ts_terms":["provenance","audit trail","invariants","confidence vector","governance decision","regulatory audit"]}' \
    '{"topic":"Identify Appendix-level EoH concepts that must be promoted into the core specification as dependent embodiments, particularly those that define reasoning constraints, state lifecycle enforcement, or drift comparison rules.","ts_terms":["appendix embodiment","dependent claim","core specification","reasoning constraint","state lifecycle"]}'

#!/bin/bash
# Complete workflow: Triage -> DEBUG_LOOP for dogfooding
# This script runs triage and automatically executes DEBUG_LOOP if recommended

cd "$(dirname "$0")"

OUTPUT_DIR="ai_coder_output/test_citation"
RUN_LOG="output/runs/test_citation/events.jsonl"

# Ensure directories exist
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$RUN_LOG")"
mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR"

# Run triage with dogfood flag and auto-execute
python3 run_triage.py \
  --config ai_coder/coder_config.yaml \
  --run-log "$RUN_LOG" \
  --failure-type crash \
  --error-excerpt "UnboundLocalError: cannot access local variable 'start' where it is not associated with a value
citation_agent.py" \
  --output-dir "$OUTPUT_DIR" \
  --dogfood \
  --execute \
  --repo-root "$(dirname "$(pwd)")"

echo ""
echo "✅ Triage -> Debug workflow complete"
echo "📄 Check debug summary: $OUTPUT_DIR/reports/debug_summary.md"

#!/bin/bash
# show_artifacts.sh - Display all artifacts from an ai_probe/ai_coder run
# Usage: ./show_artifacts.sh [suffix]
# Example: ./show_artifacts.sh timeline_provenance_v1

set -e

SUFFIX="${1:-}"
BASE_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"

# Determine output directories (both now use /<suffix>/ structure)
if [ -n "$SUFFIX" ]; then
    PROBE_DIR="$BASE_DIR/ai_probe_output/$SUFFIX"
    CODER_DIR="$BASE_DIR/ai_coder_output/$SUFFIX"
else
    echo "❌ Error: suffix is required. Usage: $0 <suffix>"
    echo "   Available probe suffixes: $(ls -1 "$BASE_DIR/ai_probe_output" 2>/dev/null | grep -v coder_reports | tr '\n' ' ')"
    echo "   Available coder suffixes: $(ls -1 "$BASE_DIR/ai_coder_output" 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^\.' | tr '\n' ' ')"
    exit 1
fi
REPORTS_DIR="$BASE_DIR/reports"
CODER_REPORTS_DIR="$BASE_DIR/ai_probe_output/coder_reports"

# Colors
CYAN='\033[0;36m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
MAGENTA='\033[0;35m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color
BOLD='\033[1m'

divider() {
    echo ""
    echo -e "${CYAN}════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════${NC}"
    echo -e "${BOLD}${GREEN}$1${NC}"
    echo -e "${CYAN}════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════${NC}"
    echo ""
}

section() {
    echo ""
    echo -e "${YELLOW}────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────${NC}"
    echo -e "${BOLD}${BLUE}$1${NC}"
    echo -e "${YELLOW}────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────${NC}"
}

file_header() {
    echo ""
    echo -e "${MAGENTA}>>> $1${NC}"
    echo ""
}

# Start report
echo ""
echo -e "${BOLD}${CYAN}╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗${NC}"
echo -e "${BOLD}${CYAN}║                        AI CODE PIPELINE ARTIFACTS                            ║${NC}"
echo -e "${BOLD}${CYAN}╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝${NC}"
echo ""
echo -e "Suffix: ${BOLD}${SUFFIX:-'(default)'}${NC}"
echo -e "Probe output: ${PROBE_DIR}"
echo -e "Coder output: ${CODER_DIR}"
echo -e "Reports: ${REPORTS_DIR}"
echo -e "Generated: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"

###############################################################################
# ENTIRE ARTIFACTS - Full content
###############################################################################

divider "📊 ENTIRE ARTIFACTS (Full Content)"

# 1. Probe Report
section "1. PROBE REPORT"
if [ -f "$PROBE_DIR/probe_report.json" ]; then
    file_header "$PROBE_DIR/probe_report.json"
    cat "$PROBE_DIR/probe_report.json"
elif [ -f "$BASE_DIR/ai_probe_output/probe_report.json" ]; then
    file_header "$BASE_DIR/ai_probe_output/probe_report.json"
    cat "$BASE_DIR/ai_probe_output/probe_report.json"
else
    echo "  (not found)"
fi

# 2. Coder Report (markdown)
section "2. CODER REPORT"
if [ -f "$CODER_DIR/coder_report.md" ]; then
    file_header "$CODER_DIR/coder_report.md"
    cat "$CODER_DIR/coder_report.md"
else
    # Try latest report
    LATEST_REPORT=$(ls -t "$REPORTS_DIR"/repo_report_*.md 2>/dev/null | head -1)
    if [ -n "$LATEST_REPORT" ]; then
        file_header "$LATEST_REPORT"
        cat "$LATEST_REPORT"
    else
        echo "  (not found)"
    fi
fi

# 3. All Patches
section "3. ALL PATCHES"

# Check reviewed patches first
REVIEWED_DIR="$CODER_DIR/diffs/reviewed"
if [ -d "$REVIEWED_DIR" ] && [ "$(ls -A "$REVIEWED_DIR" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    echo -e "\n${GREEN}=== REVIEWED (HIGH/MEDIUM confidence) ===${NC}\n"
    for patch in "$REVIEWED_DIR"/*.patch; do
        [ -f "$patch" ] || continue
        file_header "$patch"
        cat "$patch"
    done
fi

# Check suppressed patches
SUPPRESSED_DIR="$CODER_DIR/diffs/suppressed"
if [ -d "$SUPPRESSED_DIR" ] && [ "$(ls -A "$SUPPRESSED_DIR" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    echo -e "\n${YELLOW}=== SUPPRESSED (LOW confidence) ===${NC}\n"
    for patch in "$SUPPRESSED_DIR"/*.patch; do
        [ -f "$patch" ] || continue
        file_header "$patch"
        cat "$patch"
    done
fi

# Check main diffs folder (if not organized into reviewed/suppressed)
DIFFS_DIR="$CODER_DIR/diffs"
if [ -d "$DIFFS_DIR" ]; then
    for patch in "$DIFFS_DIR"/*.patch; do
        [ -f "$patch" ] || continue
        file_header "$patch"
        cat "$patch"
    done
fi

if [ ! -d "$DIFFS_DIR" ] && [ ! -d "$REVIEWED_DIR" ]; then
    echo "  (no patches found)"
fi

###############################################################################
# PARTIAL ARTIFACTS - head -n 100
###############################################################################

divider "📋 PARTIAL ARTIFACTS (First 100 lines)"

# Gap Report
section "Gap Report"
if [ -f "$PROBE_DIR/gap_report.json" ]; then
    file_header "$PROBE_DIR/gap_report.json"
    head -n 100 "$PROBE_DIR/gap_report.json"
    echo -e "\n${YELLOW}... (truncated)${NC}"
fi

# Vision Context
section "Vision Context"
if [ -f "$PROBE_DIR/vision_context.json" ]; then
    file_header "$PROBE_DIR/vision_context.json"
    head -n 100 "$PROBE_DIR/vision_context.json"
    echo -e "\n${YELLOW}... (truncated)${NC}"
fi

# Repo Vision
section "Repo Vision"
for dir in "$CODER_DIR" "$PROBE_DIR"; do
    if [ -f "$dir/repo_vision.json" ]; then
        file_header "$dir/repo_vision.json"
        head -n 100 "$dir/repo_vision.json"
        echo -e "\n${YELLOW}... (truncated)${NC}"
        break
    fi
done

# Ticket/Jira
section "Jira Ticket"
if [ -f "$CODER_DIR/jira_ticket.json" ]; then
    file_header "$CODER_DIR/jira_ticket.json"
    head -n 100 "$CODER_DIR/jira_ticket.json"
fi

# Ticket Hits
section "Ticket Hits"
if [ -f "$CODER_DIR/ticket_hits.json" ]; then
    file_header "$CODER_DIR/ticket_hits.json"
    head -n 100 "$CODER_DIR/ticket_hits.json"
    echo -e "\n${YELLOW}... (truncated)${NC}"
fi

# Probe Summary
section "Probe Summary"
if [ -f "$CODER_DIR/probe_summary.json" ]; then
    file_header "$CODER_DIR/probe_summary.json"
    head -n 100 "$CODER_DIR/probe_summary.json"
    echo -e "\n${YELLOW}... (truncated)${NC}"
fi

# Gap Summary
section "Gap Summary"  
if [ -f "$CODER_DIR/gap_summary.json" ]; then
    file_header "$CODER_DIR/gap_summary.json"
    head -n 100 "$CODER_DIR/gap_summary.json"
    echo -e "\n${YELLOW}... (truncated)${NC}"
fi

# Code Summary
section "Code Summary"
if [ -f "$CODER_DIR/code_summary.json" ]; then
    file_header "$CODER_DIR/code_summary.json"
    head -n 100 "$CODER_DIR/code_summary.json"
    echo -e "\n${YELLOW}... (truncated)${NC}"
fi

# Review Summary
section "Review Summary"
if [ -f "$CODER_DIR/review_summary.json" ]; then
    file_header "$CODER_DIR/review_summary.json"
    head -n 100 "$CODER_DIR/review_summary.json"
    echo -e "\n${YELLOW}... (truncated)${NC}"
fi

# File Overlap Report
section "File Overlap Report"
if [ -f "$CODER_DIR/file_overlap_report.json" ]; then
    file_header "$CODER_DIR/file_overlap_report.json"
    cat "$CODER_DIR/file_overlap_report.json"
fi

# TS Hits (very large, just show stats)
section "TS Hits (stats only)"
for dir in "$CODER_DIR" "$PROBE_DIR"; do
    if [ -f "$dir/ts_hits.json" ]; then
        file_header "$dir/ts_hits.json"
        echo "Lines: $(wc -l < "$dir/ts_hits.json")"
        echo "Size: $(du -h "$dir/ts_hits.json" | cut -f1)"
        echo ""
        echo "First 20 lines:"
        head -n 20 "$dir/ts_hits.json"
        echo -e "\n${YELLOW}... (truncated)${NC}"
        break
    fi
done

# Coder Reports (from ai_probe - shared hand-off point)
section "Coder Reports (ai_probe)"
if [ -d "$CODER_REPORTS_DIR" ]; then
    for report in "$CODER_REPORTS_DIR"/*.json; do
        [ -f "$report" ] || continue
        file_header "$report"
        head -n 100 "$report"
        echo -e "\n${YELLOW}... (truncated)${NC}"
    done
fi

# Followups (probe)
section "Probe Followups"
if [ -d "$PROBE_DIR/followups" ]; then
    echo "Found $(ls "$PROBE_DIR/followups"/*.json 2>/dev/null | wc -l) followup files"
    for f in "$PROBE_DIR/followups"/*.json; do
        [ -f "$f" ] || continue
        file_header "$f"
        head -n 50 "$f"
        echo -e "\n${YELLOW}... (truncated)${NC}"
    done | head -n 200
    echo -e "\n${YELLOW}... (showing first few files only)${NC}"
fi

# Gap Followups
section "Gap Followups"
if [ -d "$PROBE_DIR/gap_followups" ]; then
    echo "Found $(ls "$PROBE_DIR/gap_followups"/*.json 2>/dev/null | wc -l) gap followup files"
    for f in "$PROBE_DIR/gap_followups"/*.json; do
        [ -f "$f" ] || continue
        file_header "$f"
        head -n 50 "$f"
        echo -e "\n${YELLOW}... (truncated)${NC}"
    done | head -n 200
    echo -e "\n${YELLOW}... (showing first few files only)${NC}"
fi

###############################################################################
# Summary
###############################################################################

divider "📈 ARTIFACT SUMMARY"

echo "Probe Output ($PROBE_DIR):"
[ -d "$PROBE_DIR" ] && ls -la "$PROBE_DIR" 2>/dev/null | head -n 20 || echo "  (not found)"

echo ""
echo "Coder Output ($CODER_DIR):"
[ -d "$CODER_DIR" ] && ls -la "$CODER_DIR" 2>/dev/null | head -n 20 || echo "  (not found)"

echo ""
echo "Patches:"
[ -d "$CODER_DIR/diffs" ] && ls -la "$CODER_DIR/diffs"/*.patch 2>/dev/null || echo "  (none)"
[ -d "$CODER_DIR/diffs/reviewed" ] && echo "" && ls -la "$CODER_DIR/diffs/reviewed"/*.patch 2>/dev/null || true
[ -d "$CODER_DIR/diffs/suppressed" ] && echo "" && ls -la "$CODER_DIR/diffs/suppressed"/*.patch 2>/dev/null || true

echo ""
echo -e "${BOLD}${GREEN}Done!${NC}"

def emit(self, event: str, payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
